Deep Glizzy green body, cream yoke, red-and-cream stripes across the chest, arms, and hem, and a laced collar that says you've been doing this since before visors were optional. Up front, embroidered "Utah ♥ Glizzies" in script, Jacques, a heart, and Frank right where they belong. Together. Mmmmm.

products.name: Utah Glizzies Grandma's House Hat

"Utah Glizzies Hockey Club" stitched underneath in script (Grandma signed it herself, btw) with Grandma's suede touch on the bill.

Wear it to the rink, Sunday dinner, and everywhere you want people asking why a bear is fighting a hot dog.
